checks.name: Owned preview begins actual lifecycle dependency and Stop restores once with drafts
Rapid external Stop then independent Play cannot be stopped, paused, resumed or sought by the old preview owner
Scene/lifecycle removal or rebinding of preview target refuses startup and restores the authored scene
A lifecycle replacement with the same UUID edits only the new live component
Pending WASM startup cancellation or a changed source does not create a session
Startup exceptions after runtime activation still stop the owned session and restore
Preflight and existing global Play refuse preview without mutating runtime state
Recording reset capture is associated only with the owned session and consumed once
Actual Save refuses invalid, conflicted, missing and preview drafts without clearing or persisting them
Actual successful Save persists before clearing recovery and preserves the Curve view
Actual failed Save preserves draft/base and produces no history
Pointer click does not toggle a key selected by pointerdown; keyboard activation selects once

scope: Actual SFC compilation and extracted production handlers with explicit runtime/asset fixtures. No browser geometry or complete user workflow claim.
